data.body: Second BLOCK remediation: named and reconciled `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_help_overview_coverage.py`; bridge-status leaves the retired tuple, stays hidden in top-level help, and gains route parity while purge-bridge remains retired. Applied all useful advisories too: last-pass advances before lock release; CAS is exactly three attempts with 100/200 ms delays; canary waits the lock blobs observed lease_secs, default 120; inbound `_event_meta` and `LEGACY_JIRA_ENV_ID` remain unchanged because local identity derivation is scoped to the new last-pass writer; post-change semantic and rg sweeps are an explicit removal AC. Added ADR 0094 plus `.numbers/0094`, generated README, collision-reallocation rule, and both ADR checkers to the plan/file impact, satisfying the recently changed numbering/index convention.
